control.purpose: Slider and checkbox labels with live values.

motion.name: fade-ui
motion.purpose: Idle fade of the UI layer in fullscreen.

breakpoints.name: mobile-heuristic
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width, default particle count drops to 100.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Floating circular glass button for link and settings.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Settings"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 50%; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Icon Button
components.description: Copy link and close actions in the panel header.
components.html: <button class="ds-panel-icon" aria-label="Close settings"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-panel-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 50%; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s, background 0.3s; } .ds-panel-icon:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-panel-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: List Button
components.description: Theme, background, and reset choices in the panel.
components.css: .ds-list-btn { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 12px 15px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font: 0.95rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-list-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; } .ds-list-btn.is-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); color: #fff; font-weight: bold; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-list-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dots { display: flex; } .ds-dots i { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; margin-left: -3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(20,20,20,0.75); }

components.name: Range Slider
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Speed: 1.0x</label><input class="ds-range" type="range" min="0.1" max="3" step="0.1" value="1">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); margin-bottom: 10px; font: 0.9rem sans-serif; } .ds-range { width: 100%; -webkit-appearance: none; background: transparent; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; height: 16px; width: 16px; margin-top: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Side Panel
components.description: Right-edge smoked-glass drawer with collapsible sections.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 300px; padding: 20px; background: rgba(20,20,20,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: -5px 0 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-panel-title { color: #fff; font: 300 1.1rem sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-section { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font: 0.8rem sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 10px 0; }

components.name: Toast
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 50px; background: rgba(20,20,20,0.85); color: #fff; font: 0.95rem sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

narrative.overview: The screen is a lens wide open on a field of light. The bokeh canvas is the subject and owns every pixel of color; the interface is the lens housing: dark, smoked glass that sits at the edge of the frame and stays out of focus until someone reaches for it. When the panel is open it reads like a camera's settings screen: monochrome, precise, labeled values, no ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome white-alpha UI over translucent near-black glass.
Backdrop blur as the depth language (5px buttons, 10px toast, 15px panel).
Uppercase tracked labels for structure; sentence-case values.
One right-edge panel (300px), two circular icon buttons top-right, one pill toast bottom-center.
Motion is slow and soft: 0.2–0.5s eases, one springy curve for panel and toast.

rules.name: The No-Hue Rule
rules.body: UI chrome never uses a chromatic color. If a control needs emphasis, raise its white opacity; never tint it.

rules.name: The Opacity Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text and fills move only along the existing steps (0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0).

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Structural text is uppercase and letter-spaced; anything the user reads as a value or choice is not.

rules.name: The Blur-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: A new floating surface gets glass (translucent dark fill plus backdrop blur) before it gets a shadow.

dos: Do keep every UI surface achromatic (The No-Hue Rule) so all 29 themes read cleanly. Content previews (palette dots, thumbnails) are the one exception.
Do build new floating surfaces as glass: dark translucent fill plus backdrop blur (The Blur-Is-Depth Rule).
Do show state with white opacity steps: rest 0.05, hover 0.15, active 0.2 with a 0.4 rim.
Do keep chrome at the screen edges; the center of the canvas belongs to the light field.
Do honor reduced motion: transitions near-instant, shimmer slowed, drift off.
donts: Don't tint controls with theme colors or add brand accent colors.
Don't place persistent UI over the center of the canvas or add chrome that stays visible in idle fullscreen.
Don't use hard, opaque panels or heavy drop shadows; they break the out-of-focus optics.
Don't remove focus outlines without a visible :focus-visible replacement.
Don't offer light backgrounds (white, pale yellow); additive light disappears into them.
Don't use text-transform: capitalize on names; write the proper case in data.
